810 asotia {as-o-tee'-ah}

from a compound of 1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed
   derivative of 4982; TDNT - 1:506,87

AV - riot 2, excess 1; 3

1) an abandoned, dissolute life
2) profligacy, prodigality
